recovery_receipt_snapshot.disk_retention_plan: Only ~1.2 GB of munged inputs/reference/logs/QC; no full dense raw extraction.
recovery_receipt_snapshot.reader_mode: one sequential gzip/tar pass; one writer; <=4MB buffers

scope: Additive independent recovery/hash and printed-statistic concordance; no native estimator run, no GWAS data read, no full-precision historical recovery.
source_count_stage_note: Pinned standalone h2 parses SNP,N,Z with dropna=True; external rg parses SNP,N,Z,A1,A2 with dropna=False before post-merge dropna. Counts are not the same stage; discrepancy alone does not imply source mismatch.
